newsitem.title: USA: Texaco unit to issue $150 in notes.
newsitem.headline: Texaco unit to issue $150 in notes.

text.p: Texaco Capital Inc, a wholly-owned finance subsidiary of Texaco Inc, said Monday it was going to issue $150 million of 10-year notes in a public offering.
Texaco Capital said it is offering the notes at a price of 100 percent of par with an interest coupon rate of 7.09 percent.
The notes, which have a maturity date of February 1, 2007, are not callable during the term, it said.
Texaco Capital said it will loan the proceeds from the sale to Texaco Inc or its subsidiaries to be used for working capital, retirement of debt and other general corporate purposes.
